about: Tolerances for comparing a model's measured size with the real object and with its USDZ twin. Working values chosen for mstack; none was read from a primary source. Tighten them for products where size matters (furniture, anything that has to fit).

scale_tolerance_pct.unit: percent difference allowed between a measured side and the declared real size
scale_tolerance_pct.source: mstack working value, no primary source

twin_tolerance_pct.unit: percent difference allowed between the GLB and the USDZ on any side
twin_tolerance_pct.source: mstack working value, no primary source
